trace_format: UTF-8 JSONL; one M3_R7C_C9_PUBLIC_ROW_V1 object per physical line

input_modes.r7a-public-c9: mechanically adapt Role A M3_R7A_C9_PUBLIC_ROW_V1 / PUBLIC_ROWS_C9.jsonl

r7a_adapter_boundary.field_policy: require exactly the same 74 names, retain every value, and reorder keys mechanically to the frozen C9 schema order
r7a_adapter_boundary.source_policy: auto-bind PUBLIC_ROWS_C9.jsonl by path/bytes/SHA-256 when the published base binding is still pending; copy upstream raw_sha256 as raw_capture_sha256 and preserve line/cycle/epoch/PRE_NBA
r7a_adapter_boundary.evidence_policy: preserve upstream source, raw_ports, missing_reasons, events and semantics in upstream_evidence; bind the physical upstream row by raw_line_sha256
r7a_adapter_boundary.plan_policy: set plan_association to null; reject any non-null apply_event_seq or declaration-only association until the plan body and actual acceptance evidence are verified

fields_contract: exact ordered required list from NORMALIZED_ROW_SCHEMA_R06C9.json; 74/74; null/X/Z retained

semantic_rules.invalid_cause_sentinel: kind 3/4/8 with apply_data=0, router_apply_seq=0 and router_apply_seq_valid=0 is INVALID_CAUSE_SENTINEL
semantic_rules.same_seq_multi_stage: kind 1 and kind 2 may share a valid router sequence and remain separate ordered source rows
semantic_rules.input_plan_sequence: apply_event_seq remains null; any non-null value or declaration-only association is rejected until the independent plan body and actual acceptance evidence are read and verified; router sequence equality is insufficient
semantic_rules.frame_origin: FRAME F is derived only from frame_tick; advance_frame_req_id is preserved only as a request tag
semantic_rules.lane_advance: only exact 4'b1111 in advance_mask establishes all-four-lane advance; partial masks are false and X/Z/null are pending with raw values retained
semantic_rules.config_take: 62-bit config_payload is interpreted only with actual config_take; this bridge preserves both raw fields
semantic_rules.clip: upstream/effect/feedback two-bit masks remain separate from effect_input/result/TX clip observations
semantic_rules.audio_stable: raw value is preserved; policy and real public implementation remain pending

per_row: source including raw_line_sha256 and upstream_evidence for Role A rows
